components.name: Capture FAB
components.description: The one round element: always-visible memory capture, bottom-right.
components.css: .ds-fab { display: grid; width: 3rem; height: 3rem; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--paper); background: var(--theme-ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-slip); cursor: pointer; } .ds-fab:hover { background: var(--ink-strong); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--theme-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Inked action inside dialogs (Continue, Create Memory, Save).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid var(--theme-ink); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem; color: var(--paper); background: var(--theme-ink); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-strong); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--theme-ink) 55%, var(--paper)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--theme-ink); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem; color: var(--theme-ink); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--ink-tint); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--theme-ink) 55%, var(--paper)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Cabinet Red outline reserved for permanent deletion.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { border: 1px solid var(--danger); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem; color: var(--danger); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--danger) 8%, var(--paper)); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--danger) 55%, var(--paper)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Floating Chip
components.description: Typed paper chip for quiet canvas actions beside the FAB.
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text); background: var(--paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow-slip); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--ink-tint); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--theme-ink); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.css: .ds-slip { box-sizing: border-box; width: 320px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem 1rem; color: var(--text); background: var(--paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow-slip); } .ds-slip-no { margin: 0 0 0.15rem; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.64rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--muted); } .ds-slip-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-slip-body { font-size: 0.86rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-slip-tags { display: flex; gap: 0.3rem; margin: 0.6rem 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-slip-tag { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.64rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1.4; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tag-primary { color: var(--paper); background: oklch(0.46 0.09 305); } .ds-tag-topic { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.44 0.08 50) 55%, var(--paper)); color: oklch(0.44 0.08 50); background: var(--paper); }

components.name: Drawer Index
components.description: The minimap: a paper drawer index whose split-color specimens show primary-tag families.
components.css: .ds-minimap { position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; width: 220px; height: 160px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow-slip); } .ds-minimap-card { position: absolute; display: flex; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--theme-ink) 35%, var(--paper)); } .ds-minimap-card i { flex: 1; } .ds-minimap-card-a { top: 34px; right: 22px; width: 42px; height: 26px; } .ds-minimap-card-a i:first-child { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 305); } .ds-minimap-card-a i:last-child { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 145); } .ds-minimap-card-b { bottom: 18px; left: 78px; width: 50px; height: 28px; } .ds-minimap-card-b i:nth-child(1) { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 145); } .ds-minimap-card-b i:nth-child(2) { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 255); } .ds-minimap-card-b i:nth-child(3) { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 305); } .ds-minimap-mask { position: absolute; inset: 20px 14px 36px 22px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--theme-ink) 35%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--theme-ink) 12%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: The app is a natural-history drawer: the pile is a curated collection, and every memory is a cataloged specimen slip on an archival sheet. Museum-modern register — hairline rules, typed catalog labels, near-black ink, one quiet accent — never scrapbook-nostalgic and never productivity-SaaS. Canvas-first: no topbar, only floating controls; one theme ink derives the palette via color-mix.
keyCharacteristics: Canvas-first: the canvas is the app; there is no topbar, only floating controls.
Cards are neutral archival slips; tag color lives on labels, not on card fills.
One theme ink derives the entire UI palette via CSS color-mix.
Typed mono labels carry metadata; a grotesque carries reading text.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every chrome color derives from --theme-ink by color-mix; no second accent hue enters the interface chrome. (Tag colors and the destructive red are meaning, not chrome.)

rules.name: The Color-on-Labels Rule
rules.body: Tag color appears on labels, chips, and the minimap index — never as a full card background fill.

rules.name: The Typed Label Rule
rules.body: Metadata is set in the mono face like a catalog entry; prose is set in the grotesque. The mono is never used for body copy, and the grotesque is never tracked out like a label.

dos: Do derive every chrome color from --theme-ink via color-mix.
Do keep cards neutral; express tag identity through label color and the minimap split.
Do keep capture one click away on the canvas at all times.
Do set metadata in the typed mono face at small sizes (0.64–0.68rem).
Do preserve the persisted viewport; the owner returns to their spot.
donts: Don't fill card backgrounds with tag colors (the sticky-note look).
Don't add a topbar, sidebar, or any persistent chrome band.
Don't use pill radii, dot grids, or a second accent hue in the chrome.
Don't add a dark mode; the scene is a desk in daylight.
Don't animate canvas content or add hover effects to slips; motion belongs to dialog entrances only.
